Usage: headroom launches [flags]

List the newest launches, or judge how automatic placement has done.

The newest launches from the launch log, one line each: when, which account, how it was
decided, the load and weekly figure it was decided on, how long that week had left, and the
account that would have been next. --json prints the records as logged, one per line.

--eval judges automatic placement instead, per rule version: windows its launches went into
that reached a limit while another account had room, weekly room that may have renewed
unspent, and the launches this binary's rule would decide differently. These are observed
outcomes, not what another choice would have caused. A partial: line names a home or file
it could not read; a fault: line counts launches this binary's rule decides differently
from what was logged under its name, so that rule's figures mix two rules. It reads the
launch logs of every home on the ledger and the usage log, and asks nothing. --since narrows it to a span back from
now (7d, 36h, 90m) or from a date (2026-10-01).

Flags:
      --vendor=VENDOR      Only this vendor's accounts; every vendor on this machine when absent
                           (one of: claude, codex).
  -n, --count=INT          How many of the newest launches to list; 0 lists every one (default: 20).
      --json               Print the records, or with --eval the evaluation, as JSON.
      --eval               Judge how automatic placement has done instead of listing launches.
      --since=SPAN|DATE    With --eval, only what happened since: a span back from now (7d, 36h) or
                           a date (2026-10-01).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.
      --version            Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                           exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
